ConnectionStrings.//: Set via user secrets or environment variables. Never commit credentials (SOW 3 - Security).

Collection.//: Data source is [DATA SOURCE - TBD] pending sponsor sign-off (SOW 0.1). With SourceUrl empty the worker starts, logs, and idles.

Parser.//: Selector profile for the confirmed source. RecordSelector is XPath matching one node per record; each field Selector is XPath relative to that node and must start with '.' to stay scoped. Filled in at source sign-off - the example below shows the shape.

Fields.//: Keys map to snapshot columns: SourceKey, Title, CategoryCode, CategoryName, SourceUrl, PrimaryValue, SecondaryValue, Quantity, StatusText, CurrencyCode, PublishedAtUtc. Any other key is stored as an extension attribute under that name.
